verdict.rationale: Ubuntu Desktop's first-party docs show it ships a terminal environment and a command-line tutorial, so a CLI is part of the product. Nothing in the evidence describes an official CLI built for AI-native or agentic workflows, such as structured output or agent-oriented commands. missing for 10: an official Ubuntu-specific CLI documented for AI/agent workflows, documented commands or automation surface, machine-readable output, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
